name: IG2

chatHistory.content:
25-second b-roll animation, minimal text, visual-first. Complements voiceover about chaining four Apify Instagram scrapers.    Apify brand styling, dark background, subtle ambient motion.
                                                                   Concept: abstract flow of nodes/cards drifting across the frame — each beat highlights one scraper with just its name (small,
   lower-corner or as a label) and a distinctive visual motif. No captions, no descriptions, no UI mockups.

                      Beats:

  - 0:00–0:03.5 — A single profile node: avatar circle + a couple of post tiles orbiting it. Label: Instagram Profile Scraper.   - 0:03.5–0:07 — A hashtag glyph (#) with a small cluster of post thumbnails spilling from it. Label: Instagram Hashtag         Scraper.
  - 0:07–0:13 — The hashtag branches outward into related hashtag nodes — a small network expanding. Label: Related Hashtag      Scraper.
  - 0:13–0:20 — A map pin drops, with a few location-tagged post tiles fanning out around it. Label: Instagram Scraper.          - 0:20–0:25 — Hold on the final beat, gentle drift.

                                                                            Motion: springy entrances, soft fades between beats, continuous ambient drift so it never feels static. No hard cuts.
  Thumbnails are abstract placeholders (rounded rects with subtle gradient), not real images.

- no fade in/out at the end
- no fade when the scene changes
- no background
- remove the apify logo
- remove the texts at bottom left
can you remove the glows please?
remove the "+" symbol from it and use "Corner_Background_Orange" for the background
